title: The Zwicky Transient Facility Bright Transient Survey. III. BTSbot: Automated Identification and Follow-up of Bright Transients with Deep Learning

episodes.description: Human BTS scanning of one candidate: filtered alert viewed by scanner, saved or not, spectrum requested at a priority, SEDM spectrum, classification (SNIascore or manual), TNS report.

chain.op: BTS alert filter (braai, sgscore, magnitude) reduces to ~50 candidates/night
classification by SNIascore or manually by scanner

episodes.description: Automated BTSbot workflow for one source in production: Kowalski features and crossmatch, BTSbot score, policy auto-save/auto-trigger, SEDM, pySEDM, SNIascore, TNS.

chain.op: ML models run incl. BTSbot score
BTS alert filter as database query

Branches B05 and B23 are the only object-specific ones outside the scanning episode; B23 is a counterfactual, not a taken decision. No per-object branch concerns model-family choice or light-curve fitting. Selective labels: rejects and non-triggered sources have no spectroscopic outcome.
